title: A Peterson program for general Schubert varieties and mirror symmetry
summary: We initiate a `Peterson program' that seeks to extend Dale Peterson's theory for the quantum cohomology of flag varieties to arbitrary Schubert varieties, and that incorporates a mirror-symmetric approach. In this first paper we introduce a generalisation of the (localised) Peterson variety associated to an arbitrary Schubert variety $\check X_{w,P}$ inside a partial flag variety $\check G/\check P$.
